newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Chrysler CEO says yen undervalued.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Chrysler CEO says yen undervalued.

text.p: Chrysler Corp chief executive and president Robert Eaton, a member of the U.S. president's advisory committee on trade policy, said on Tuesday the yen was dramatically undervalued and should be 100 yen to the dollar.
"Dramatically. Everybody in the world would agree that the yen is undervalued," Eaton told reporters after a luncheon in Sydney for journalists.
He had been asked whether the yen was undervalued.

"We believe quite frankly that the structural rate of the yen should be somewhere around 100 (yen to the dollar)," he said. Eaton said the yen exchange rate would be a crucial factor in the health of the world car inductry in coming years.

He said many believed the Japanese government had manipulated the yen lower and should remove itself from the market. "All we want is the Japanese government to do is to stay the hell out of the market," he said.
"In the yen, they're the ones who have been distorting the market. It hasn't anything to do with being a rational, free and open market," he said.
At 1.55 p.m. (0255 GMT) the U.S. dollar was trading at 123.42/47 yen.
